archetypes.name: dyn-status-truthiness
archetypes.rationale: Detector must gate on same-scope semantic evidence and avoid optional-string false positives.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect lint_status_routing_truthiness.py and its tests for evidence collection, bare-truthiness contexts, scope isolation, and occurrence identity. Confirm optional status-suffixed values without same-scope members are not flagged, and that #6153-shaped first reachable truthiness still fails. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
